name: Genshousanzou Guhou no Tabi - TRIPITAKA
original_name: 玄奘三蔵求法の旅 TRIPITAKA
source: Tripitaka is a Japanese educational adventure game and the second game in the Cosmology of Asia series, following Cosmology of Kyoto. The game tells the story of Genjōsanzō (better known under his Chinese name, Xuanzang), a Chinese Buddhist monk in the 7th century who embarked on a pilgrimage to India in order to attain enlightenment.
translation: 《玄奘三藏求法之旅TRIPITAKA》是一款日本历史教育冒险游戏，也是继《京都千年物语》之后推出的“亚洲宇宙论”系列第二部作品。游戏讲述了公元7世纪中国佛教高僧玄奘三藏（即玄奘）远赴天竺求法证道的传奇西行历程。
